items.a: No. Elderbrook Masonry is invented. This build is a demonstration of a design family, published so the design can be shown without linking a real client's site or a prospect's private pitch.

items.q: Why does my new pointing look wrong?
items.a: Usually because a hard modern mortar was used on a soft old wall. It traps moisture and the brick face spalls. It can be cut out and done again.
We source to match and cut on site. An exact match is not always possible, and we will tell you before starting rather than after.

items.q: How long before I can walk on a new patio?
items.a: It depends on the material and the weather, and we will give you a straight answer for your job rather than a number from a brochure.
